diagram.manim_description: On a plain BG canvas draw two left-aligned rows of factorisation text in INK, row 1 above row 2, with the two equals signs in one vertical line and a clear gap between the rows (about 1.6 times the text height). Row 1 reads 30 = 2 × 3 × 5 (three factors: 2, 3, 5). Row 2 reads 72 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 3 × 3 (five factors: 2, 2, 2, 3, 3). Both rows start their first factor at the same x position; row 1 therefore ends well before row 2. Draw two FOCUS outlines (2.5 px stroke, rounded corners, no fill). Outline 1: one tall rounded rectangle enclosing the first factor 2 of row 1 and the first factor 2 of row 2 (it spans the height of both rows in that one column). Outline 2: one connected step-shaped outline that encloses the second factor 3 of row 1 and the fourth factor 3 of row 2 (the first 3 of 72) together: a rounded box round the 3 of row 1, a rounded box round the fourth factor of row 2, joined by a horizontal bridge that runs from the 3 of row 1 down and to the right through the gap between the rows to the fourth factor of row 2. The 5 of row 1, the second and third factors 2 and the last factor 3 of row 2 carry no outline. Below the rows, horizontally centred under row 2, draw the result line HCF = 2 × 3 = 6 in ANSWER green (letters, equals signs, crosses and digits all ANSWER). Keep an even small margin round the drawing.
